summary: 78-year-old Chicago man injured his ankle on the Estes Cone Trail; rangers notified at the Longs Peak Ranger Station about 1 p.m. reached him around 2:45 p.m., treated his injury on site, and assisted him on horseback to the trailhead; he then got himself to Estes Park Medical Center for treatment shortly after 5 p.m.
location: Estes Cone Trail, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: NPS Rocky Mountain National Park rangers
